candidatos.titulo: Connecting Product Outcomes to Business Strategy
candidatos.descripcion: Every product has to create real value for a group of people and the business, at least in theory. But in practice, that’s not always the case. With AI driving more digital products, it’s more important than ever to successfully connect products and business strategy and make smart investment decisions. This article shows you how to do it.
